Fonts used by blender/ib_text.py to build in-world lettering (glyphs are converted to flat meshes at kit build time;
the font files are not shipped with the game). All are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (licence texts
alongside):

  BebasNeue-Regular.ttf   Bebas Neue (Dharma Type)                 OFL-BebasNeue.txt          ib_text 'display'
  Oswald.ttf              Oswald, variable (Oswald Project)         OFL-Oswald.txt             ib_text 'cond'
  PlayfairDisplay.ttf     Playfair Display, variable (C. Eggers)    OFL-PlayfairDisplay.txt    ib_text 'serif'
  Pacifico-Regular.ttf    Pacifico (Pacifico Project)               OFL-Pacifico.txt           ib_text 'script'
  Inter-Bold.otf          Inter Bold (Inter Project, R. Andersson)  OFL-Inter.txt              ib_text 'sans'

Sources: github.com/google/fonts (ofl/...), github.com/rsms/inter.
